distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) provide mainland records from 黑龙江 and 陕西. Beaver & Liu (2010) includes Dryocoetes autographus in the accepted Taiwan checklist, adding Taiwan occurrence.

host_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) provide explicit host taxa. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Picea and Pinus, rarely Abies and Larix, but explicitly states that no Taiwan hosts were recorded. Genus-level host information is retained without assigning those hosts specifically to Taiwan.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Dryocoetes autographus (Ratzeburg, 1837).
